# Managed by hand. The top of this file looks hardened.
Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf
Port 22
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
LogLevel VERBOSE

# ... two hundred lines of comments and defaults ...

Match Group deploy
	PasswordAuthentication yes
	AllowTcpForwarding yes

Match Address 10.0.0.0/8
	PermitRootLogin yes
